what: Initial post-commit run of acquisition helper (canonized in benchmarks/early_phase_geographic_footprint/acquire_locations_fixture.py) called client.get('clinicaltrials-gov', 'api/v2/studies/{nct_id}') on first sorted trial NCT00016744
why: catalog.yaml base_url for clinicaltrials-gov already ends in /api/v2, so prefixing api/v2/ produced HTTP 404 (resp.data=None) and aborted fail-closed on NCT00016744 with zero study payloads read; corrected path to studies/{nct_id} with explicit Status.FOUND assertion before any empirical location record was fetched.

what: Pre-registered PRED-0018 hypothesis that early-phase systemic CFTR trials (N_sys=54) register multi-country (>= 2 non-WITHDRAWN sovereign countries) clinical trial site networks at one-sided Fisher p < 0.01 and 95% risk-difference CI lower bound > 0 vs pure airway-restricted inhaled CFTR trials (N_inh_pure=15; N_inh_all=17)
why: Refuted on measured ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 contactsLocationsModule data without post-hoc tuning: 26/54 (0.481481) systemic trials vs 5/15 (0.333333; NCT02532764, NCT02564354, NCT06429176, NCT06515002, NCT06962852) pure-inhaled trials and 7/17 (0.411765; adding NCT05668741, NCT06237335) all-inhaled trials registered >= 2 sovereign countries, giving risk difference +0.148148, one-sided Fisher p = 10424417/44368472 = 0.23495100 (>= 0.01; all-17 p = 0.41302790), Chan-Zhang 95% CI [-0.149733, 0.396110] (lower bound <= 0), and Newcombe-Wilson 95% CI [-0.132089, 0.371460] (lower bound <= 0), both straddling zero.

what: Round-1 tightening of _newton_bisect_mn_p2_decimal in independent_audit.py set eps = Decimal('1e-18') at 28-digit precision
why: At boundary d_start = -1 + 1e-12, lo = 0.999999999999 and (hi - lo) * eps = 1e-30 underflowed below 1 ulp(lo) in 28-digit Decimal arithmetic, leaving a == lo and causing DivisionByZero on p1 = a + delta == 0; fixed by enforcing margin = max((hi - lo) * rel_eps, floor_p) with floor_p = 1e-24 (28-digit) / 1e-46 (50-digit) and clamping p1_c, p2_c.
